# Align on final 5.1 launch theme & plan
Date: 2026-08-24 | Duration: 30.700000762939453m

## Summary
The team discussed product messaging and positioning, emphasizing the need to scale experimentation through a core message centered on volume, value, and culture. Key features aimed at enhancing experimentation speed, quality, and insights were identified, including contextual bandits and a Slack app. The participants recognized the importance of velocity as a primary theme, with culture serving as a foundational element to drive faster learning. AI and automation enhancements were highlighted as crucial for reducing friction in the experimentation process. Additionally, a communication strategy was developed to ensure that detailed release notes would be separated from the main blog post to maintain focus on core themes while still addressing additional features.

## Keywords
experimentation, AI automation, product analytics, launch messaging, contextual bandits, culture

## Action Items

**Elyse Fox**
Rework the 5.1 launch messaging with a stronger focus on speed/velocity and culture as an enabler; circulate the revised version for feedback (29:20)

**Jeremy Dorn**
Prepare to finalize top features and confirm release scope including User Journeys and Slack app readiness (23:05)

**Scott Bailey**
Assist with articulating the narrative of feature integration along experimentation workflow stages for launch messaging (21:53)

**Unassigned**
Utilize office hours and release notes to cover all features in the 5.1 launch ecosystem, even if not fully included in the primary blog post (19:41)
